decision_rules.condition: Mission produces data consumed by automated systems

decision_rules.condition: Mission duration > 2 hours OR multi-session investigation
decision_rules.action: Add checkpoint save/restore after each major stage
decision_rules.rationale: Long missions need resumability; checkpoints prevent lost work

decision_rules.condition: Complex mission requiring multiple skill sets

decision_rules.rationale: Specialist agents provide better quality and cost efficiency

decision_rules.condition: Task can be completed by multiple models

decision_rules.rationale: Multi-model reduces rate limits, optimizes costs, improves availability
